name: Autonomous Financial Deep Research & Intelligence Blueprint
authorities: Ed Donner (Former Managing Director JPMorgan Chase, AI Engineering Instructor)
canonical_references: Latent Space: Context Engineering for Deep Agents
description: Production-grade autonomous financial research agent. Combines LangGraph dynamic Send API fan-out, Docling table-preserving chunking, hybrid dense/BM25 retrieval, an AST-checked deterministic Python execution sandbox for zero-hallucination math, and an adversarial compliance critic.

nodes.name: Query Decomposition & Planning Node
nodes.description: Deconstructs high-level investment thesis into parallel typed micro-tasks across quantitative statements, MD&A qualitative narratives, and risk factors.

nodes.name: Dynamic Hybrid Retrieval Worker
nodes.description: Dynamically spawned via Send API. Executes hybrid dense semantic search and BM25 sparse keyword matching over Docling-parsed SEC filings and earnings transcripts.

nodes.name: Deterministic Quantitative Python Sandbox
nodes.description: AST-restricted execution environment computing FCF, YoY growth, CAGR, net debt, and solvency ratios using Decimal precision with SHA-256 audit trails.

nodes.name: Lead Financial Dossier Synthesis Node
nodes.description: Drafts structured institutional research dossier with inline citations and audited markdown performance tables.

nodes.name: Adversarial Compliance & Grounding Critic
nodes.description: Cross-examines draft against raw filing citations and verified calculation logs. Rejects drafts with arithmetic divergence or ungrounded claims.

target_sections: Item 8: Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
